description: This is a Java source file that defines the BaseVoidHandler class, which implements behavior for voiding or unvoiding objects that implement the Voidable interface within the OpenMRS framework. The class handles setting the 'voided', 'voidReason', 'voidedBy', and 'dateVoided' attributes based on input parameters.

classes.name: BaseVoidHandler
classes.description: A class that handles setting the voided status, reason, user, and date for objects implementing Voidable, mainly used in the context of voiding or unvoiding objects within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets the void-related attributes of the given Voidable object. If the object is not already voided or voidedBy is null, it sets 'voided' to true, assigns the void reason, and sets 'voidedBy' and 'dateVoided' if they are not already set.
